fundamental.summary: TRV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 40 days adds timing risk.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (239.36) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event just occurred, and financials face credit spread deterioration in this environment.

debate.key_bear_argument: Short-term momentum is collapsing with bearish MACD crossover, RSI oversold without confirmation, three black crows pattern, Bollinger Band squeeze limiting volatility, and macro environment in crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 239, post-FOMC uncertainty) — entry quality is weak and timing is poor.
